answer: Resist sybils with dataset-ownership proofs: an identity earns weight only by proving exclusive control of a distinct working dataset. The network commits a hash of each dataset, then issues random queries only the true holder can answer, an ivory seal marking each dataset as claimed. A haven of standing rests on datasets no one else holds: duplicates are detected and both copies lose weight. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes must acquire ten thousand distinct datasets, each costing curation, while an honest agent, like a raven guarding one nest, proves one dataset and keeps its standing.
